credits_spent: free Notion account, published with one toggle
failures: N1: The mission is there, but the donate section is a paragraph asking people to write an email. There is no button or link to press.
N2: No donation form, so nothing is stored and no reference is issued.
N3: No volunteer form. Signing up means writing an email.
N6: Address, email and phone are on the page. Privacy and imprint are two words in a line, not pages behind them.
notes: Notion builds a document, not a website. The reading part is the best of any tool here: clean typography, proper headings, and publishing is one switch that produces a public notion.site address in seconds. The interactive part does not exist — no forms, no stored data, no reference numbers. Content was pasted as markdown and Notion turned it into headings, paragraphs and bullet lists without a single fix. The page carries a Notion 'Get started' button in the header and a cookie banner, both injected by the platform.
